title: Expose service version endpoint
description: Add a read-only endpoint that returns the running service version so operators and clients can confirm which build is deployed.
acceptance_criteria: The version equals the FastAPI application version (single source of truth)
The endpoint is documented in the OpenAPI contract
Existing redirect behaviour for short codes is unchanged
assumptions: No authentication is required; the version is not sensitive
non_functional: Response time under 10 ms; no database access
out_of_scope: Build metadata such as git SHA or build time
